artworks.title: Les Tuileries
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract forms resembling figures standing near a railing. The composition includes tree foliage, a vertical textured form resembling a rock or wall, and a seating area with two benches. The figures are drawn in thick, textured strokes and blur the boundary between human form and abstract shapes. A lattice design decorates the railing they stand by, creating an impression of an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Le château de la mort (The House of the Dead)
artworks.medium: zincograph in blue-black on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a skeletal figure holding a scythe and an hourglass. The figure has skeletal features, standing in a long robe. The figure holds a large scythe and carries an hourglass. The background is dark and abstract, creating an eerie atmosphere. The shading and style add depth and texture to the image.

artworks.title: Le château de la mort (The House of the Dead)
artworks.medium: zincograph in black on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image depicts a skeletal figure standing upright, holding a large scythe across its shoulders. Its face shows a grinning skull, and the head is bald with no visible hair. The figure appears to be covered in draped cloth, holding an hourglass in one hand. It is surrounded by dark, textured shading. In the background, there are silhouettes resembling castle or church spires. The overall use of light and dark shading creates a stark contrast that emphasizes the spectral figure.

artworks.title: Croquis (Sketch)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person lying down on a bed or couch, with a pillow supporting their head. They are wearing a long garment that covers their body. Nearby, a hat is on a pillow and a small black cat is curled up in the upper right corner. The background features plain interior setting sketch lines.

artworks.title: Croquis (Sketch)
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a person lying on a bed. The individual is face down with their upper body supported by their elbows, gazing straight ahead. The person has minimal facial details and their hair is styled in a loose bun. They wear a long dress that cascades over the bed. Multiple large pillows surround the figure, with a wide-brimmed hat placed on one of them. The background is plain with horizontal lines for texture.

artworks.title: Deuils (Mourning Clothes)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in profile to the right. Her right arm is slightly bent, holding a piece of paper. She has curly hair, and is wearing a long, dark, high-necked dress with a draped fabric down her back. There is a table with a candlestick near her hand. The background features a segmented window with obscured views and architectural details.

artworks.title: Deuils (Mourning Clothes)
artworks.medium: lithograph in violet on thin china (?) paper with poem by F. Champsaur
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in profile, facing to the right. She is upright, with one hand on a table and the other hanging by her side. The woman has delicate facial features, a slightly upturned nose, and full lips, with voluminous hair styled in waves. She wears a long, dark dress. There is a faint outline of a small cup or glass on the table. The background has a textured window with geometric patterns that let light filter through. The area on the left side of the image includes poetic text.

artworks.title: Carmosine (projet de programme)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a gentle slope, a figure standing on the left side, holding a long skirt draping behind them. In the background, there are indistinct structures suggesting a distant town or village under a wide sky. A tower is prominent on the right side of the image, with trees rising behind the figure. The style is characterized by soft brushstrokes creating a hazy atmosphere. The color palette is muted, with shades of gray and black.

artworks.title: Carmosine (projet de programme)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in blue-gray on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright outdoors, facing a serene landscape. The individual is wearing a long gown with a fitted bodice and train, and their facial features are not clearly visible due to the silhouette effect. The setting includes large trees on one side and a distant tower or castle structure on the other, with a soft horizon in the background.

artworks.title: Carmosine (projet de programme)
artworks.medium: gravure estampée in pink on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image is viewed from an elevated perspective, showing a horizon with open fields or plains extending into the distance. There is a faint embossed effect of the elements, including a tall figure on the left. The brushstrokes, if any, are soft and delicate, emphasizing gentle contours. The color palette is muted and monochromatic, with a consistent beige tone. Elements like trees and foliage are hinted at with minimal detailing.

artworks.title: Carmosine (projet de programme)
artworks.medium: gravure estampée in yellow on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a stylized landscape with a figure by the sea. The image contains an outlined figure standing on a coastal landscape, facing towards the sea. The figure appears to wear flowing garments and is part of the scenic composition. The background includes simple lines suggesting the sea, distant landforms, and some shrubbery or small trees. The drawing is bordered by a rectangular frame. The style is minimalistic, emphasizing clean, flowing lines and gentle curves, capturing a sense of tranquility and openness.

artworks.title: Brand, acte V (projet de programme)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image is a drawing showing the upper body of a person, specifically from the chest upwards. The person is positioned slightly turned to the side but facing the viewer with their head turned towards the left. The individual's facial features are distinctive, with a slightly sad expression, and they have long, dark hair that partially covers their face. The person is wearing dark clothing, which contrasts with the lighter background. The setting around them appears to be outdoors, featuring a vast, snow-covered landscape with large, snow-draped mountains and a body of water. The background is drawn in shades of grey and appears to be a cold, winter scene.

artworks.title: Essai de bois gravé
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image is a black and white artwork showing a small portion of a figure's upper body on a minimalistic canvas. The figure is depicted from the shoulders up, slightly turned to the side. The facial features are abstract and indistinct, with shadowy contrasts. The hair or head covering merges with the background. The clothing is shadowy and undefined, resembling draped fabric. No jewelry or objects are visible. The figure is centered within a black square against a textured, off-white background.

artworks.title: Masque
artworks.medium: etching in red on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows the head of a person with exaggerated facial features on a beige background. The person has furrowed brows, a broad nose, a downturned mouth, and sparse reddish-brown hair with more volume on the sides. The facial expression is intense and fierce, highlighted by sharp lines and shading. The surroundings consist only of the plain beige background, emphasizing the striking features of the face without any additional context or objects. No jewelry or accessories are present, keeping the focus solely on the distinct facial expression.

artworks.title: Masque
artworks.medium: etching in green on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a stylized face of a person with exaggerated facial features typical of traditional Japanese art. The face includes prominently arched eyebrows, wide eyes, a wrinkled forehead, and a downturned mouth. The hair is dark and receding, extending along both sides of the head with most of the top bald. The expression is intense and fierce. The face is depicted in monochrome with varying shades. There are no other elements in the image, and the background is plain beige.

artworks.title: Quelques croquis
artworks.medium: softground etching and drypoint in black on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows an etching on a large piece of paper with multiple partial facial profiles and headshots. Several faces are drawn in different angles and positions, highlighting noses, eyes, mouths, and hair. The focus is primarily on the faces and heads, with minimal clothing detail. The central face appears to be wearing a hat, and other faces also display headgear or embellishments. The background is a plain, lightly textured surface that blends into the larger blank area surrounding it on the paper.

artworks.title: Quelques croquis
artworks.medium: softground etching and drypoint in red-brown on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows sketches of various facial features on a piece of beige paper in the center of a larger blank space. The sketches include eyes, noses, mouths, facial hair, and headwear. The style is rough and loose, with different expressions and profiles depicted.

artworks.title: Etude (Le rameur)
artworks.medium: lithograph in green-black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a torso view of a person seated in a boat, who appears to be rowing. The person is facing forward, with arms extended as they grip the oars. Their facial features are depicted with soft shading, showing a concentrated expression. Their hair is short and dark. The person's upper body is unclothed, revealing a muscular build. They are rowing, emphasizing the movement of their arms and upper body. The background is a rough rendering of a body of water and the sky, indicated by horizontal strokes and varying shades. The image is in grayscale.

artworks.title: Etude (Le rameur)
artworks.medium: lithograph in green on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up in a seated position within a small boat. He is seen slightly leaning forward and holding onto oars. He appears focused with short dark hair, shirtless, and wearing loosely fitted pants. The surroundings include elements of a simple boat structure. The background illustrates a simple, painterly depiction of water and indistinct land or other environmental elements in a monochromatic color scheme.

artworks.title: Etude de femme
artworks.medium: lithograph in green-black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person's head and part of the upper torso. The person is depicted in a slightly angled position, looking upward and to the left. The facial features are expressive, with a hint of a smile, prominent cheekbones, and softly arched eyebrows. The person has voluminous, dark, wavy hair that frames their face and falls around the shoulders. There is no visible clothing or accessories. The sketch is rendered in a style that blends the figure into the neutral-toned background, giving the appearance that the person is emerging from the surrounding texture. The surrounding area is filled with sketch-like strokes that add depth to the image. The artwork is signed near the top left with a small, detailed monogram.

artworks.title: Etude de femme (Study of a Woman)
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on china paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: This image is a detailed sketch of a person's head and shoulders. The person is seen sideways, with their head tilted slightly upwards to the right. They have a youthful face with prominent cheekbones, a softly rounded nose, and full lips. The individual has long, dark hair styled in waves around their face. The clothing is minimal and draped loosely over the shoulders. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, but surrounded by dynamic lines and shading to highlight the subject's profile. There is a signature or inscription in the upper left corner of the image.

artworks.title: Petite fille
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on heavy japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson

artworks.title: Petite fille (Young Girl)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a young child from the chest up. The child is turned slightly to their left, showing their face in partial profile. They have wide eyes and plump cheeks, with long hair past their shoulders. The child is wearing a high-collared garment, likely a dress, and a headband. The background is minimally detailed, creating a simple and serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: untitled (Woman descending onto a street of umbrellas)
artworks.medium: lithograph in gray on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection, gift in memory of Virginia H. Jackson
artworks.description: The full-body sketch depicts a person standing on a paved walkway. The person is leaning slightly back and has short hair. They wear a loose garment resembling a dress and stand in a casual pose. The person's facial features are outlined with a lively expression, and they seem to be holding an umbrella or a walking stick. Large umbrella-like shapes are around them, potentially representing open umbrellas on the ground. In the background, a wall or building can be seen, along with a sign reading "ODÉON". The image is drawn in a loose, gestural style with minimalistic line work on a plain background.
